name: Drum Stand / Metal Rod protection caps

captions.detailed: A 3D-printable protective end cap designed to fit over metal rods. It features a hollow cylindrical body that transitions into a smooth, rounded hemispherical dome at the closed end. The open end has a uniform wall thickness, revealing a clean, circular inner cavity meant to snuggly fit a rod.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric protective cap for metal rods in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to configure the hole_diameter, overall height, and wall_thickness of the cap, ensuring the closed end transitions into a smooth hemispherical dome.
captions.factory: The design uses a custom module called 'protector' which combines a hollow cylinder and a hollow sphere. The hollow cylinder is created using a difference of two concentric cylinders (outer and inner radius). The hemispherical cap is created by taking a sphere of the outer radius and subtracting a cylinder to leave only the upper dome. These parts are assembled, translated, and a final difference operation cuts away any excess base using a cube to ensure a flat starting plane.
